caption:
Chilli Oil Anda Bhurji
2 things that shouldnt go together but do :)

C: 27 | F: 14 | P: 16
Calories: 298 per serving 
Serves 1

Ingredients
1 tsp chilli oil, go as per your preference here, more /  less spicy types
2 eggs
1 onion + 2 cloves of a garlic + 1/2 inch ginger + 1 green chilli, minced 
1 tomato, diced
salt + pepper to taste
spring onion for garnish 

Method: 
add your chilli oil to a pan followed by your onion mix and cook till translucent 
add in the tomatoes and allow to cook for 2-3 minutes till mushy
add in the eggs & salt + pepper and cook till done
I like to switch off the flame when the egg is still slightly runny so it cooks with latest heat
serve with pav, bread or eat as is with a side salad :)
